intro: One piece of roti telur has an estimated 400 kcal, not including kuah. Most calories come from the roti canai dough and oil, while the egg adds protein.
diet: Yes, and roti telur is actually a better choice than two pieces of roti kosong. The egg gives protein that helps you feel full. One piece with kuah dal and a kosong drink is enough for breakfast. Just don't make it your daily menu every morning.
tips: Choose one roti telur over two roti kosong.
Take kuah dal and avoid kuah kari with santan.
Add a boiled egg or have warm water, not a sweet drink.

swap.name: Thosai telur
swap.why: You still get the egg protein, but thosai uses less oil than roti canai.

faq.q: Roti telur or roti canai kosong, which is better for diet?
faq.a: One roti telur keeps you fuller than one roti kosong because of the protein. This helps you avoid snacking early.

faq.q: Is roti double telur worth it?
faq.a: If you want more protein, sure. But calories go up by about 80 kcal, so count it in your daily budget.

faq.q: Can I ask for roti telur with less oil?
faq.a: You can try asking the roti man to use less oil when cooking. Some shops are okay with it, especially if you're a regular.
